description: The Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health (ARPA-H) is hosting a Proposers’ Day (PD) in support of the Delphi program. The Proposers’ Day will be held virtually and in-person on March 27th, 2026, from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Mountain Time (MT) in Tempe, Arizona. Advance registration is required (https://solutions.arpa-h.gov/delphi).
